description: One data row of exec/costs_month.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8. Retired names: schema_version 2.0 renamed a column (org_id is now provider_account_id).

cost_basis_label.description: Plain-language label of the basis of usage_cost_source.

cost_source_basis.description: What cost_source is: billed, consumption or estimate; mixed if the rows differ.

currency.description: ISO 4217 reference currency of the row.

hidden.description: True when a privacy rule withheld at least one covered value of the row; empty values then mean withheld.

invoice_usage.description: Invoiced usage amount from the invoice file, if one was given.

provider.description: Provider the usage or seats came from, as the silver records name it.

provider_account_id.description: Provider account label from the silver records; empty only where seats are matched on provider alone.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

seat_cost.description: Seat fee: seats_billed times seat_price. A fee, not usage.

usage_cost_ref.description: Sum of cost_ref over the provider's usage rows.

usage_cost_source.description: Sum of cost_source over the provider's usage rows.

title: gold-dataset-exec-costs_month
x-cost-column-rule: For spend by provider and month sum `usage_cost_ref` (reference cost) or `total_cost_ref` (usage plus seats). Never add `seat_cost` to `total_cost_ref`: it is already inside. Sum `usage_cost_source` only within one `cost_source_basis`.
x-grain: One row per month, provider and provider account.
